sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful for COMPLEX_READINESS: applicability violations are correctly inverted, all declared operands and result terms are present on their authoritative owners, UIWL/LIWL relationships and upper-waterline geometry are represented, KiloW unit constraints support the direct power comparison, and the readiness boundary correctly avoids reconstructing the informational source formula.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability SPARQL constraints: in SHACL-SPARQL, rows selected are violations, but the first branch currently selects a row exactly when the requirement is applicable, while the second selects a row exactly when it is non-applicable. Invert both conditions so the applicable branch reports a violation only when the date/class applicability condition is false, and the non-applicable branch reports a violation only when that condition is true. Otherwise applicable ships can pass through the empty non-applicable branch without required inputs, and non-applicable ships fail both alternatives.

Keep the corrected applicability SPARQL inversion from the prior instruction. Add explicit qudt:unit constraints with qudt:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloW> to minimumRequiredPowerAtLowerIceWaterline and minimumRequiredPowerAtUpperIceWaterline quantity nodes; these canonical terms declare KiloW as their recommended unit, and the direct comparison must be between explicitly unit-consistent power quantities.

Preserve the prior applicability inversion. Add explicit qudt:unit constraints with sh:hasValue <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloW>, sh:minCount 1, and sh:maxCount 1 to the quantity nodes for nltl:minimumRequiredPowerAtLowerIceWaterline and nltl:minimumRequiredPowerAtUpperIceWaterline. The prior required unit-consistency repair remains absent, so the candidate is not ready to freeze.

Candidate is semantically faithful for COMPLEX_READINESS: applicability violations are correctly inverted, all declared operands and result terms are present on their authoritative owners, UIWL/LIWL relationships and upper-waterline geometry are represented, KiloW unit constraints support the direct power comparison, and the readiness boundary correctly avoids reconstructing the informational source formula.
